critical_code_review_comments: At 1024px viewport the paragraph has scrollWidth 892px inside a max-w-3xl (768px) parent because of whitespace-nowrap; it does not cause page horizontal scroll (parent section has enough padding), but if the user resizes below ~892px available width the text will overflow. Current lg breakpoint (1024px) is a tight fit; consider raising the nowrap breakpoint or shortening the copy if strict containment matters.
